title: How to make the BEST sugar cookies! Part 2 from yesterday 🎄 #sugarcoo...
description: How to make the BEST sugar cookies! Part 2 from yesterday 🎄 #sugarcookies #learnintiktok #christmasbaking #tiktokfood #food
transcript: Here tell to make sugar cookies. Add softened butter and granulated sugar to a bowl and cream these together. Add one egg and vanilla and whisk these in. Add plain flour, maybe use a bigger sieve than I did. Bacon powder and salt and sift these into the mix. Mix these in with your hands to form a dough. Split the dough and roll it out on a floured surface. Grab your cookie cutter and cut out your shapes then pull off any excess to use again. Carefully transfer your cookies to a baking tray and bake in the oven for about 6 minutes. Enjoy!
